newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian big banks shares hit new heights.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian big banks shares hit new heights.

text.p: Continued investor demand for yield-rich blue chips fuelled a rise in the bank sector on Monday, despite Commonwealth Bank of Australia shedding a 45 cents dividend, brokers said.
Sector leader, National Australia Bank, turned in a sterling performance, setting sail for the A$17.00 mark and peaking at A$16.95, up 41 cents on the day and at a record high.
"National Australia Bank is looking sensational but all the banks are looking very good. None of them look dreary by any means," said a Sydney broker.
